**All tests pass!** ✓

The bug was in line 24 of `/tmp/h-bug_grouping-8k1zc10o/invoicing/money.py`. The condition for grouping digits in the head section was `len(head) > 3`, but for proper Indian digit grouping, it should be `len(head) > 2`.

In Indian numbering, the rightmost group has 3 digits and all other groups to the left have exactly 2 digits. By changing the condition to `> 2`, the algorithm now correctly extracts 2-digit groups from the head until reaching 2 or fewer remaining digits.

This fixes the example: 12345678 paise now correctly displays as "₹1,23,456.78" instead of "₹123,456.78".
